stem: A homepage redesign shows a relative lift in clicks of +10% in week 1 and +1% in week 3. What is the most likely interpretation?

options.text: Primacy: users are still getting used to it, so the lift will keep growing
Novelty: users clicked because it was new, so plan on the later, stable value
A bug: a real effect never changes in size from one week to the next
The average of all the weeks is the long-run effect, so plan on that
